verdict.rationale: CrewAI is a Python framework with an official CLI to create, train, run, and manage crews and flows. `crewai test` runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports metrics, and deployed crews can be triggered programmatically via the REST API (POST /kickoff, GET /status, POST /resume). Together these support unattended, scriptable execution. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, non-interactive flags, exit-code semantics) and independent hands-on reports of running crews in CI pipelines.
